steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 排序同分的名次語意不同；ROWS 框架用實際列位置，須用唯一鍵建立可重現順序。 交付可供另一人重建的輸入表，任何自行加入的假設需另列。
steps.checkEn: Ranking functions handle peers differently; a ROWS frame uses physical row positions and needs a unique tie breaker. Deliver reconstructible input tables and list every added assumption.

steps.instruction:
建立soft-v29-077-evidence資料夾，交付input.csv或事件表、基準推算、變更後結果、故障判讀與驗收紀錄。每個視窗都明寫分組、排序及框架，將同分案例加入回歸測試。 保存來源網址、執行環境及明示的模型界限。 本課有可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v29/labs-data.py --lab soft-v29-077 --out ./soft-v29-077-evidence；輸出目錄須不存在。
在交接件中加入「資料契約、介面與不變量」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：排序同分的名次語意不同；ROWS 框架用實際列位置，須用唯一鍵建立可重現順序。 交付可供另一人重建的輸入表，任何自行加入的假設需另列。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：對同分成績比較 ROW_NUMBER、RANK、DENSE_RANK，並核對累積總分。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Create soft-v29-077-evidence with input.csv or an event table,baseline calculations,changed outcomes,diagnosis and acceptance records. Specify partition,ordering and frame for each window and retain ties as regression cases. Retain source URL,runtime and model limits. Executable lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v29/labs-data.py --lab soft-v29-077 --out ./soft-v29-077-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Data contracts,interfaces and invariants: Ranking functions handle peers differently; a ROWS frame uses physical row positions and needs a unique tie breaker. Deliver reconstructible input tables and list every added assumption.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Compare ROW_NUMBER,RANK,DENSE_RANK on ties and reconcile running totals. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。排序同分的名次語意不同；ROWS 框架用實際列位置，須用唯一鍵建立可重現順序。 交付可供另一人重建的輸入表，任何自行加入的假設需另列。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. stages.description: 對同分成績比較 ROW_NUMBER、RANK、DENSE_RANK，並核對累積總分。 四名學員 (id,score)=(1,90),(2,90),(3,80),(4,70)，順序 score DESC,id ASC。 將鍵、型別、時間或版本欄分列，指出每筆資料的唯一身份；對NULL、重複或無限邊界做明確約定。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare ROW_NUMBER,RANK,DENSE_RANK on ties and reconcile running totals. Learners are (1,90),(2,90),(3,80),(4,70), ordered score DESC,id ASC. Tabulate keys,types,time/version fields and stable identities; explicitly handle NULLs,duplicates and unbounded endpoints.
